description: Import trace markers positions. The positions are contained in the space-delimited ASCII text file s .
notes: Every point in the file must lie inside the mine-block model. On MassFlow 9.7.47 a file with a point outside it terminates the process at import time — the file reader does no bounds check.
`massflow marker trace position <x> <y> <z>` does check, and answers `Trace marker - No valid mineblock found at (x,y,z).` Use it to validate coordinates before committing them to a file.
File format: see reference topic 'file-formats trace-markers'.
